data.name: Devacharan
data.gender_notes: Devacharan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name 'Devacharan' is derived from Sanskrit language. It is a compound of two words: 'Deva' meaning 'God' and 'Chara' meaning 'Journey'. Hence, the name Devacharan signifies the journey of God. The name Devacharan carries the meaning “God's Journey” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devacharan usually hope their child will grow to embody god's journey and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A divine and spiritual journey towards enlightenment.
data.etymology: Devacharan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Journey.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Devacharan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
